description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called ContextMenuCardView that displays a context usage card at the top of a macOS menu bar menu, showing session information and token usage bars.

classes.name: ContextMenuCardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a context usage card, displaying session details and token usage.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for ContextMenuCardView, sets rows, status text, and loading state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy for the context menu card.

methods.name: subtitle
methods.description: Computes a subtitle string based on the number of sessions.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Builds a view representing a single session row with token usage bar and labels.

methods.name: placeholderRow
methods.description: Builds a placeholder row view shown when loading.
